conflicts: etrain.info live timetable shows origin as Veraval (VRL) due to Somnath (SMNH) physical closure.
trains.notes: etrain.info's own row for this direction lists source_station as VRL (not SMNH), inconsistent with the 19119 direction which lists SMNH as endpoint. Somnath (SMNH) station has been closed for redevelopment since approx. 1 Sept 2022 (multiple independent sources confirm it remained closed as of mid-2026: ixigo's SMNH station page, dated Aug 2026, states no trains currently pass through it; IndiaRailInfo forum posts and Wanderlog site reviews describe it as under reconstruction with all services diverted to Veraval Junction). The public timetable record for this train still names/routes it to SMNH with Veraval shown as a very brief (1-5 min) intermediate halt, but since SMNH is not physically operating, the currently effective terminus/origin for this service is Veraval Junction (VRL). This is recorded as an unresolved conflict rather than silently corrected.
